mentions.name: Orbital
mentions.description: This tool lets users orchestrate AI agents as nodes in a graph with explicit dependencies, so multiple agents can be fanned out in parallel and their progress tracked, offering more control than a chat-thread interface.
mentions.problem: Chat-thread interfaces give poor control and visibility when running multiple AI agents in parallel.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building something in this direction - instead of a chat thread, agents are nodes in a graph with explicit dependencies, so you can fan out a few in parallel and see where each one is. The control story is much better than a chat. Not my daily driver for coding yet.
